context: Adjacency matrix mapping 105 D3 blocks (rows) × 26 skills (columns), with cells colored by 7 skill categories and interactive zoom/pan plus hover row-column highlighting
first_impression: Dense but structured — the matrix reads as a coherent skill coverage map rather than a wall of noise, though individual cells are near the minimum legible size at initial zoom.
what_works: The 7-category color palette stays within perceptual limits and the hues are distinct enough to scan columns by category; hover highlighting that dims non-matching rows and columns is well-executed and makes cross-referencing tractable in a 105×26 grid.
what_doesnt: At the auto-fit initial scale, row labels and 11px cells are compressed to roughly 4–5px rendered size, requiring zoom before any label is readable — the visualization effectively hides its own content on load; the rotated skill labels at -55° combined with small cell size make column identification slow without hovering.
